experiment: Post-primary separately registered full-cell soft-policy learning
scope: This is a new experiment. Original FREEZE.json, all original candidates and primary confirmation endpoints remain unchanged. Registered after primary confirmation was inspected; added to complete the requested full-cell learning stage. Fixed 30-step settings reuse R7 budget; the four new heldout configurations/worlds have not been evaluated or used for tuning.

initialization.source: Every family's own original R7 fits_primary/{family}_none_{seed}.json, never a calibrated candidate
initialization.common_non_direct_law: Constant drift Brownian, leak=0, dt=1, voltage grid N=15, 12 image terms; tick-end recovery with inherited reference probability and full reset/survivor law
initialization.direct_kernel: r8-full-joint-direct-v1; identity latent transition and no internal events
initialization.native_scope: All new checkpoints have hepta.full-joint-policy.v1 schema and are rejected by the old R7 native loader. Native deployment is not implied.

training.configurations: Exactly the eight original R7 task_configuration(0..7), all 738 public states; equal weight per configuration
training.objective: Only negative complete finite-DAG expected registered utility of the soft action policy over sampled internal states. No critic/myopic regression, detached Q targets, straight-through estimators, entropy penalty, or private-world supervision.
training.utility: Terminal task quality minus original task action/latency fees minus 0.0005 per decision minus 0.0002 per newly emitted model event
training.transition_order: Propagate and observe internal state; pay current compute/event cost; choose public legal action; integrate every external successor and future reset/recovery/event/policy branch. STOP pays the already incurred incoming transition fees once.
training.normalization: Differentiate through the same nonnegative row normalization used by hard_soft sampling from a one-hot predecessor; event rewards are recomputed from normalized active-to-refractory probabilities.
training.inactive: All raw_leak scalars are frozen; direct core/drive are frozen; continuous reset/recovery are unreachable and frozen. Head 0 output rows remain stored but receive no gradient under the head 1 objective. Shared hidden readout parameters are trained.
training.head_meaning: Pure-return-trained outputs are action-policy scores. They are not claimed to estimate calibrated Q-star or Q-pi.
training.selection: Retain every final update-30 model and every failure. No early stopping, best-epoch selection, seed replacement, or heldout-driven hyperparameter tuning.
training.runtime: Torch CPU FP64, one thread per process. N=15 is fixed. If measured resource use makes the registered plan impractical, stop and publish a prospective amendment; do not silently lower N or updates.

development_validation.scope: Only synthetic tiny graphs, before formal training and without heldout evaluation
checks: H=2 explicit 16-world and full latent/action-path expectation
H=4 full-return finite differences through content, drive, diffusion, boundary, reset, recovery and readout
at most two Adam updates per family on a separate tiny development fixture; N remains 15; record time and peak RSS
development_validation.separation: Development fixture weights are not candidates and cannot initialize the formal runs.

evaluation.order: Complete all 20 training runs; freeze every initial/final checkpoint hash; then evaluate the four new heldout configurations. No partial heldout readout during training.
evaluation.exact: Report initial/final soft-policy and greedy-policy exact finite-DAG utility, decisions and events on nominal eight and new heldout four configurations. Greedy conversion is separate from the trained soft-policy objective.
comparisons: Within-family final minus initial for each of five fits
FPT final minus clocked final for each fit
FPT final minus direct final for each fit
evaluation.inference: Report all five fit-level paired differences and descriptive means. This appendix does not add or replace primary-confirmation hypotheses; no significance or superiority claim from the small rollout sample.
evaluation.deployment: Actual Python Policy(deployment=hard_soft, head=1) with frozen final weights and matched original task.step; no new native qualification

rollout.indexing: seed_start + (fit_seed-11)*10000 + episode_index; config = episode_index modulo regime configuration count
rollout.pairing: Identical private world and keyed internal/action uniforms for initial/final and every family within fit. All states passed to the policy are public.
rollout.interpretation: Compare sample mean and standard error to exact soft expectation as a deployment diagnostic. Retain raw paths and every attempted run; do not tune from discrepancies or claim Monte Carlo equality.

artifacts: REGISTRATION.json with source and R7 checkpoint hashes
31 exact-return records and 30 complete pre-clip gradient vectors per fit
per-step group norms and clipped norms
publication: Root must publish this protocol and source registration remotely before formal training. Candidate identities are frozen before heldout evaluation. Original R7 and prior Round8 freeze files are not modified.
